description: Request for `POST /api/v1/sv/check-fsm` — the SV lift fields plus the FSM width bound. Lifts the module and auto-scans every FSM register for a reachable illegal encoding (no property to name). Returns a [`Btor2CheckFsmResponse`].

max_width.description: Max state-register width treated as an FSM (wider = datapath/counter, skipped).

merge_clock_domains.description: Lift a multi-clock design onto the model's one implicit clock instead of refusing it. An UNDER-approximation: the domains only ever tick together, so a HOLDS does not transfer (the `clock-domains-merged` soundness caveat). Default `false` (refused at lift time).

top.description: Top module for the lift (auto-detect when omitted).

use_slang.description: Force the slang RTL front-end (`read_slang`). Requires the yosys-slang plugin. Default `false`.

title: SvCheckFsmRequest
